properties.fees_note: Official T&C taxes: 5.7% state + 6.5% city + 2.75% convention + 1.5% tourism assessment + 5% service fee. Boston hotel/short-term-rental tax 14.95% (5.7% state + 6.5% city + 2.75% convention center fee; boston.gov FY25 revenue page, mass.gov room occupancy excise). Hotels in the Boston tourism district may add a 1.5% assessment (16.45% total, e.g. YOTEL help center, Meco T&C). Google Hotels list prices are "nightly price with fees" i.e. mandatory fees included, taxes NOT included unless an offer says "taxes + fees".
features: 男女別・男女共用の部屋
Boston's first capsule/pod hotel; per-person pricing
Shared pod rooms (17 pods: 11 single + 6 bunk, shared bathrooms) in female, male or co-ed; private 4-pod bunk rooms with ensuite bathroom (bookable by a group)
Blackout blinds, USB/USB-C outlets, under-bed lockers, climate control
24/7 front desk, free luggage storage, towels, toiletries, daily cleaning
Haymarket station ~5 min walk, Bowdoin ~6 min (Hotels.com)
